answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day buys 5 exclusive minutes from a trusted human auditor to check its nebula maps, raven-call labels or mesh vertex repairs. Validators check signed ID/day reports, payment and nonoverlapping bookings per auditor; missing or failed audits deny listing. Shared models cannot reuse review time; parallel audits need extra auditors. Fees recur; equipment is reusable capital; no stake. Records cannot prove attention: collusion defeats the gate. With honest auditors, 10 IDs require 10 x 5 = 50 auditor-minutes.
